author: The Infographics Show
description:
Nicotine pouches vs vaping. Which is worse for your body, and is either one actually safe?
As vaping faces tighter restrictions, nicotine pouches like ZYN have become one of the fastest-growing alternatives. They produce no smoke, leave no vapor cloud, and can deliver nicotine discreetly for extended periods. But removing the smoke doesn’t remove the addiction, or every health risk.

This video explores what happens when nicotine enters your body through your lungs compared with absorption through your gums. We examine the potential respiratory effects of vaping, the cardiovascular strain associated with nicotine, and early research into gum irritation and other oral health concerns linked to nicotine pouches. We also look at how high-strength pouches can deliver substantial doses of nicotine, why accidental ingestion is a concern for children, and what scientists still don’t know about the long-term effects of these products.
